description.zh: 用于校验Keyless server服务端证书的CA证书，当Verify为true时有效。
description.en: The CA certificate used to verify the server certificate of the keyless server. This parameter applies only when `Verify` is set to `true`.

description.zh: 客户端证书，需要和客户端私钥成对出现。
description.en: The client certificate. This parameter must be used with the `ClientPrivateKey` parameter.

description.zh: 客户端私钥，需要和客户端证书成对出现。
description.en: The client private key. This parameter must be used with the `ClientCertificate` parameter.

description.zh: Keyless server主机名，取值域名或IP地址。
description.en: The hostname of the keyless server. The value can be a domain name or an IP address.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

description.zh: 是否校验Keyless server服务端证书，默认false。
description.en: Specifies whether to verify the server certificate of the keyless server. Default: false.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa set-keyless-server --site-id 1234560000 --host keyless.example.com --port 443 --verify true --ca-certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----0000 --client-certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----0000 --client-private-key -----BEGIN_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----0000 --id baba39055622c008b90285a8838e0000 --name example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa SetKeylessServer --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --Port 443 --Host 'keyless.example.com' --CaCertificate '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----0000' --ClientPrivateKey '-----BEGIN_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----0000' --Id baba39055622c008b90285a8838e0000 --Verify true --ClientCertificate '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----0000' --Name example
